content_zh:
在现代来讲，薛遥的母亲是周姨娘，但古代的庶子应该管正房夫人叫母亲，平时多数喊她“太太”。
古代人的称呼其实很好理解，大多是随下人称呼，譬如薛遥他爹是薛家三老爷，名叫薛承，三房的丫头小厮就称他“老爷”或“承三老爷”，儿子、妻子、姨太太平日也喊他“老爷”，甚至连老太爷和老太太也喊他“老爷”，这就叫随下人称呼。
当然，儿子也能喊他“父亲”，父母可以对他直呼其名，都看各家习惯罢了。
这是薛遥这两天观察出来的结果，毕竟原主是个八岁小孩，称呼都随习惯，对规则却不甚了解，都得薛遥自己琢磨。
此刻，薛遥心里惦记着刚刚那声系统提示，没心思琢磨“扣半吊月钱”是个多大的处罚，直接磕头应下了。
太太回房后，周姨娘对自己的孝顺儿子又是心疼又是欣慰，忙拿出自己牙缝里攒下的体己钱，交给薛遥的贴身丫头，要她别省了遥哥儿上学堂时的吃喝，缺的那半吊钱，都由她来贴补。
薛遥如果接受生母的钱财，刚刚听见的那6点洗白点，恐怕要被扣回去，于是赶紧推拒了周姨娘的好意，说宫里学堂会提供糕点，不需要自备食物。
周姨娘这才作罢，又夸他两句，才回房歇了。
薛遥回到东厢，支开丫头婆子，独自开始研究刚刚的“系统提示”。
他试着小声发出命令：“系统的回应。
当他回忆起“反派做个人系统”这个口令，脑海中突然出现一个幽暗的空间。
空间内有一个立体的巨大魔方，每个方格都是散发着微光的半透明玻璃。
薛遥尝试着将精神力集中在魔方的一个小方块上，视线距离立即拉近了，他仿佛身历其境地漂浮在那个方块正前方。
方格内似乎锁着某种物品，但隔着半透明地玻璃，无法完全看清。
刚刚那系统提示说，洗白点达到50，才可以他刚刚只加了6点，或许根本无法解锁魔方，薛遥只好暂且作罢，睁开眼就退出了精神空间。
心情有点激动，这明显就是个金手指啊，虽然暂时不知道能派上什么用场，但至少给了他一点盼头。
既然是“反派做个人系统”，所谓的“洗白点”，一定是靠学雷锋做好事来挣了。
目前看来，孝敬亲妈也算是洗白，那他要不要给周姨娘送一床棉被去试试？
薛遥说试就试，一晚上东厢西厢两边跑，端茶递水送棉被，直到天黑，才听到一声提示音：【非实质性帮助的作秀行为达到三件，洗白点-1】。
薛遥：“？？？”

怎么还扣分！
作秀行为？晴天霹雳！
这系统这么实在的吗！
薛遥蔫搭搭地败退了。
辗转反侧的夜晚，他能想到的出路只有两条：一个是去帮七皇子把小木马的耳朵尾巴修理好，另一个，就指望这系统兑换里，有些保命的法宝。
然而，目前两条路都很迷茫。
七皇子才三岁，并不跟三皇子在一处念书。
小说里，前期的反派八成都被三皇子党给占了，实际上，那些事件之间，多则相隔数年，少则数周。
作为三皇子的侍读，薛遥根本不可能随随便便见到幼崽期的龙傲天。
那么现在，可行性较高的出路，也就是找有实际意义的好事去做，刷些“洗白点”，看看能兑换什么好东西。
于是接下来的一星期，薛遥每天从尚书房回府后，都打起十二分精神，在薛府内外院瞎晃，祈祷父老乡亲遇到什么麻烦，等他来解救。
然而他只是个八岁孩童，肩不能扛手不能提，体力忙帮不上，思想境界也达不到替凡人排忧解难的层次。
他最终帮上的忙，是院子里的一个仆妇割伤了手，他拿了自己房里的药膏，给仆妇治伤。
洗白点 2。
就这系统的小气劲儿看来，他就算把自己的私有物品全捐出去，也挣不到50积分！
这日上午，薛家老太太要去庙里，只让大房儿媳王氏陪着一起去。
薛遥跟随父亲，一路送老太太出薛府。
老太太上车时，腿脚不太麻利，抬了三次脚，才踩上脚蹬。
这一幕，忽然激发了薛遥的记忆！

content_en:
In modern terms, Xue Yao's mother is Aunt Zhou, but in ancient times, concubines should call the wife of the first wife mother, and usually call her "Mrs."
The names of ancient people are actually easy to understand. Most of them are called by subordinates. For example, Xue Yao's father is the third master of the Xue family, and his name is Xue Cheng. The girls and servants in the third room call him "Master" or "Master Chengsan". His son, wife, concubine also call him "Master" on weekdays, and even the old man and the old lady also call him "Master". This is called the title of subordinates.
Of course, the son can also call him "father", and the parents can call him by his first name. It all depends on the customs of each family.
This is the result of Xue Yao's observations in the past two days. After all, the original owner is an eight-year-old child. He is called according to habit and does not know the rules very well. Xue Yao has to figure it out by himself.
At this moment, Xue Yao was thinking about the system prompt just now. He didn't have the time to think about how big a punishment "withholding half of the monthly payment" was, so he kowtowed and accepted it.
After the wife returned to the room, Aunt Zhou felt distressed and happy for her filial son. She hurriedly took out the personal money she had saved between her teeth and gave it to Xue Yao's personal maid, asking her not to miss the food and drinks that Brother Yao had when he went to school. She would make up for the half of the money that was missing.
If Xue Yao accepted money from his biological mother, he was afraid that the 6-point cleanup point he just heard about would be deducted, so he quickly rejected Aunt Zhou's kindness, saying that the palace academy would provide pastries and there was no need to bring his own food.
Aunt Zhou then gave up and praised him a few more times before going back to her room to rest.
Xue Yao returned to the east chamber, sent the girl away, and started studying the "system prompt" alone.
He tried to whisper a command: "System's response.
When he recalled the password "Villains make personal systems", a dark space suddenly appeared in his mind.
There is a huge three-dimensional Rubik's Cube in the space, and each square is made of translucent glass that emits a shimmering light.
Xue Yao tried to focus his mental energy on a small square of the Rubik's Cube. The distance between his eyes immediately narrowed, and he seemed to be floating directly in front of the square.
There seems to be something locked inside the square, but it cannot be fully seen through the translucent glass.
Just now, the system prompted that the whitewash points reached 50. He had only added 6 points, and it might not be possible to unlock the Rubik's Cube at all. Xue Yao had no choice but to give up for the time being, opened his eyes and exited the mental space.
He felt a little excited. This was obviously a golden finger. Although he didn't know what use it could be used for, it at least gave him some hope.
Since it is a "villain making a personal system", the so-called "whitewash" must be earned by imitating Lei Feng and doing good deeds.
At present, it seems that being filial to one's own mother can be regarded as a clean slate. Then should he give Aunt Zhou a quilt to try?
Xue Yao gave it a try. He ran between the east and west compartments all night, carrying tea and water, and quilts. It wasn't until dark that he heard a sound: [Three acts of non-substantial help for show, whitewash point -1].
Xue Yao: "? ? ? "
Why are points deducted!
Show act? A bolt from the blue!
Is this system so realistic?
Xue Yao retreated in defeat.
During the night of tossing and turning, he could only think of two ways out: one was to help the Seventh Prince repair the ears and tail of the little wooden horse, and the other was to hope that there were some life-saving magic weapons in this system exchange.
However, both paths are currently unclear.
The seventh prince is only three years old and does not study in the same school as the third prince.
In the novel, 80% of the early villains were taken over by the Three Princes. In fact, the intervals between those events were years or weeks at most.
As the third prince's attendant, it was impossible for Xue Yao to casually meet Long Aotian in his cub stage.
So now, the more feasible way out is to find good things with practical significance, earn some "whitewash points", and see what good things can be exchanged.
So for the next week, Xue Yao would get up every day after returning home from Shangshufang.He was wandering around the inner and outer courtyards of Xue Mansion, praying that his fellow villagers would encounter any trouble and wait for him to rescue them.
However, he was only an eight-year-old child. He could not carry it on his shoulders or lift it. He was not physically able to help, and his ideological level was not at the level of solving problems for ordinary people.
The last thing he helped was when a servant girl in the yard cut her hand. He took ointment from his room and treated the injury.
Whitening point 2.
Judging from the stingy nature of this system, even if he donated all his personal belongings, he still wouldn't be able to earn 50 points!
This morning, the old lady of the Xue family wanted to go to the temple, and she only asked the eldest daughter-in-law, Mrs. Wang, to accompany her.
Xue Yao followed his father and escorted the old lady out of Xue's house.
When the old lady got into the car, her legs and feet were not very agile. She had to lift her feet three times before she stepped on the pedals.
This scene suddenly triggered Xue Yao's memory!
